title: terminal
description: A terminal window showing a recorded agent session: a typed command, an activity log of the newest lines that fit, a task list and a file list. Driven by props only: `shown` says how many of the script's events are visible, and the task statuses and the file list are derived from those events. Usually set with `advance` on the slide.

script.description: Path to a JSON file, relative to the deck root: { title, command, tasks: string[], events: [...] }. Every event is one log line. Event types: note, read, run, result (shown as `out`), error, code (optional `lang`) with `text`; file with the path in `text` and optional `status` created|edited (listed under Files); task with `index` (0-based into `tasks`) and `status` pending|active|done (line `<task>: <status>`; the Tasks list shows the last shown status, and a task no shown event names stays pending). The README (catalog terminal --json, field readme) has a complete example script.

shown.description: How many events are visible (events 0..shown-1). The log shows the newest lines that fit its box; tasks and files are derived from the same events. 0 is an empty prompt; the command line appears once shown is above 0. Values above the event count are clamped. Moving forward by one step animates the new lines in; any other move renders directly. Set it per step with `advance` on the element.

typing.description: When true, the command is typed character by character the first time it appears in an animated step (shown goes from 0 to above 0). Otherwise it appears whole.
